entry.title: ProFTPD mod_sql SQL Injection Enables Auth Bypass and RCE
entry.content:
CVE-2026-421672026-04-28
SQL Injection

ProFTPD mod_sql SQL Injection Enables Auth Bypass and RCE

ProFTPD's mod_sql logging path treats attacker-controlled values as already escaped when they begin and end with single quotes, allowing SQL injection through configured log expansions such as USER. Depending on server configuration, the flaw can be exploited before authentication and can lead to authentication bypass, privilege escalation, credential exfiltration, or remote code execution.
